verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a file storage and sync product, since buyers routinely compare against self-hostable alternatives, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Dropbox as a cloud service with APIs and SDKs for its hosted platform. Those SDKs are developer building blocks against Dropbox's cloud, not a way to run the core product on your own infrastructure, and nothing in the pack documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment option.
